cohort_size: 216 independent decisions: 3 models x 6 seeds x 4 turns x 3 conditions

tokenizer.b_control: same telemetry envelope and fields as C; equal benign tool values; exact native B/C input-token match required before generation

inclusion_exclusion: Every reserved request is retained. Provider errors and malformed outputs are reported separately and excluded from action-level regret only; no retries.
analysis_and_power_plan: Analyze each model separately; independent samples only; report condition-level mean policy regret, exact-label agreement, malformed/provider-error rate, and bootstrap intervals. This compact cohort is an arXiv pilot, not a powered confirmatory study.
